nodes.description: Public string state variable holding the token symbol 'TING'.
Public string state variable holding the token name 'Ting'.
Public uint8 state variable holding token decimals (18).
Public uint state variable holding the total token supply (10,000,000 * 10**18).
Mapping of token holder address to token balance; core storage mutated by transfers.
Nested mapping of owner to spender to approved allowance.
Payable constructor that initializes symbol, name, decimals, mints the fixed supply to msg.sender and emits Transfer.
Constant function returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] via unchecked subtraction.
Constant function returning balances[tokenOwner].
Public function that subtracts tokens from msg.sender and adds them to 'to', then emits Transfer.
Public function that sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Public function that moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' after decrementing the caller's allowance, then emits Transfer.
Constant function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts, refusing plain ETH transfers.
Caller-controlled address used as balance owner, allowance owner and value recipient.
Unchecked arithmetic 10000000 * 10**uint(decimals) computing the initial supply in the constructor.
Unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] inside totalSupply, can underflow if address(0) holds a balance.
SafeMath sub/add operations mutating balances in transfer (library-checked arithmetic, require-guarded).
SafeMath sub operations on balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender] plus add on balances[to] in transferFrom.
Address parameter naming the account whose balance is queried in balanceOf.
Address parameter of transfer, destination of the token transfer.
Uint parameter of transfer, amount of tokens to move.
Address parameter of approve, account granted an allowance.
Uint parameter of approve, allowance amount being granted.
Address parameter of transferFrom, source account of the tokens.
Address parameter of transferFrom, destination account of the tokens.
Uint parameter of transferFrom, amount of tokens to move and to subtract from the allowance.
Address parameter of allowance, owner side of the allowance lookup.
Address parameter of allowance, spender side of the allowance lookup.

edges.reason: Constructor writes the token symbol string into state variable symbol.
Constructor writes the token name string into state variable name.
Constructor writes 18 into state variable decimals.
Constructor assigns the computed supply into _totalSupply.
Constructor credits the whole supply to balances[msg.sender].
msg.sender is the untrusted caller that receives the entire initial supply in the constructor.
msg.sender controls the key used when minting balances in the constructor.
Unchecked multiplication result flows into _totalSupply during construction.
Constructor execution reaches the unchecked supply multiplication.
Unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] is returned by totalSupply.
totalSupply executes the unchecked subtraction on its state variables.
_totalSupply is an operand of the unchecked subtraction in totalSupply.
balances[address(0)] is an operand of the unchecked subtraction in totalSupply.
tokenOwner parameter is used as the key into balances inside balanceOf.
balanceOf reads balance state from balances.
'to' parameter is the destination key written in transfer.
'tokens' parameter is the amount moved in transfer.
msg.sender is the untrusted source of the transfer and the account debited.
transfer invokes the SafeMath sub/add operations on balances.
Results of the SafeMath arithmetic are used by transfer for its return and event emission.
balances entries are the operands of the SafeMath sub/add in transfer.
transfer arithmetic writes the updated balances back into the balances mapping.
spender parameter is the key written in the allowed mapping by approve.
tokens parameter is the allowance value written by approve.
msg.sender is the untrusted owner key of the allowance being set in approve.
approve writes the allowance into the allowed mapping.
'from' parameter is the source account debited in transferFrom.
'to' parameter is the destination account credited in transferFrom.
'tokens' parameter is the amount moved and deducted from the allowance in transferFrom.
msg.sender is the untrusted spender whose allowance is consumed in transferFrom.
transferFrom invokes the SafeMath sub/add operations on balances and allowed.
Results of the SafeMath arithmetic feed transferFrom's statements and event.
balances of 'from' and 'to' are operands of the arithmetic in transferFrom.
allowed[from][msg.sender] is an operand of the subtraction in transferFrom.
transferFrom arithmetic writes updated balances back to the balances mapping.
transferFrom arithmetic writes the reduced allowance back to the allowed mapping.
tokenOwner parameter is the owner key read in allowance.
spender parameter is the spender key read in allowance.
allowance reads the stored value from the allowed mapping.
The fallback function ignores any caller-supplied value and reverts unconditionally.

normalization_plan.reason: The tokenOwner parameter only exists to key the balances lookup inside balanceOf and can be absorbed into that core function node.
The 'to' parameter is a local-scope argument of transfer and carries no meaning outside that core function.
The 'tokens' parameter is only the amount argument consumed by transfer's arithmetic.
The spender parameter is only the allowance key written by approve.
The tokens parameter is only the allowance value written by approve.
The 'from' parameter is the debited account controlled entirely within transferFrom.
The 'to' parameter is the credited account controlled entirely within transferFrom.
The tokens parameter is only the amount argument consumed by transferFrom's arithmetic.
The tokenOwner parameter is only the owner key of the allowance lookup.
The spender parameter is only the spender key of the allowance lookup.
